about: The web.view contract (docs/plugin-api.md 3 G3a): what droidtop and an app that shows droidtop's pages (droidtop Browser) send each other. droidtop's WebViewProvidersContractTest checks droidtop against it; droidtop Browser's CI checks its adapter against it, at the droidtop commit it pins. Change both sides with it.
